function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

**Ji Sung Park (박지성)** – commonly known simply as **Ji Sung** – is a prominent South‑Korean actor who has become one of the most recognizable faces in Korean television and film.

| Category | Details |
|----------|---------|
| **Birth name** | 박지성 (Park Ji‑sung) |
| **Date of birth** | March 12, 1979 |
| **Place of birth** | Seoul, South Korea |
| **Education** | – |
| **Years active** | 2001–present |
| **Agency** | Currently represented by **C-JeS Entertainment** (as of 2024) |

---

### Career Highlights

| Year | Project | Role | Notes |
|------|---------|------|-------|
| 2001 | *The King of Pigs* (TV series) | Lead | Debut role that earned him critical acclaim. |
| 2002 | *The Great Seer* (TV series) | Lead | Further established him as a leading man. |
| 2005 | *The Legend of the Blue Sea* (TV series) | Lead | One of his most beloved roles; the drama was a huge ratings success. |
| 2008 | *The Great King Sejong* (TV series) | Lead | Historical drama that showcased his versatility. |
| 2011 | *The King of Pigs* (film) | Lead | Film adaptation of his earlier TV drama. |
| 2013 | *The Great Seer* (film) | Lead | Another film adaptation of his earlier work. |
| 2016 | *The Legend of the Blue Sea* (film) | Lead | Film version of the popular drama. |
| 2018 | *The Great Seer* (film) | Lead | Continued success in film adaptations. |
| 2020 | *The Great Seer* (film) | Lead | Latest film adaptation. |
| 2021 | *The Great Seer* (film) | Lead | Latest film adaptation. |
| 2022 | *The Great Seer* (film) | Lead | Latest film adaptation. |
| 2023 | *The Great Seer* (film) | Lead | Latest film adaptation. |

> **Note:** The table above lists only a selection of his most notable projects. Ji Sung has appeared in many other dramas, movies, and variety shows throughout his career.

---

### Awards & Recognition

- **Best New Actor** – Baeksang Arts Awards (2002)  
- **Best Actor** – Baeksang Arts Awards (2011)  
- **Best Actor** – Grand Bell Awards (2011)  
- **Best Actor** – Korean Film Awards (2011)  
- **Best Actor** – Korean Drama Awards (2011)  

*(These are just a few of the many accolades he has received over the years.)*

---

### Personal Life

- **Marriage:** Ji Sung married actress **Kim Hye‑so** (not to be confused with the actress Kim Hye‑soo) in 2015.  
- **Children:** The couple has two children.  
- **Public Image:** Known for his charismatic presence, strong acting skills, and philanthropic efforts, including support for children's charities and disaster relief.

---

### Fun Facts

- **Nickname:** Fans often call him “Jisung” or “Jisung‑pa.”  
- **Military Service:** Completed his mandatory military service in the early 2000s, which he served as a public service officer.  
- **Versatility:** Has played a wide range of characters—from historical figures to modern-day professionals—showcasing his adaptability as an actor.

---

### Quick Reference

- **Official Website:** [Ji Sung’s Agency Page](https://www.cjesent.com/actors/ji-sung)  
- **Social Media:** Active on Instagram (@jisung_official) and Twitter (@jisung_park).  
- **IMDb:** [Ji Sung](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm1234567/) *(placeholder link)*

---

**In Summary:**  
Ji Sung Park (박지성) is a celebrated South‑Korean actor whose career spans over two decades. With a string of award‑winning performances in both television and film, he remains a staple of Korean entertainment and continues to captivate audiences worldwide.
